title: krnl
description: a no-compromises performance modpack, intended to be a base for other modpacks.
body:
Krnl is a no-compromises performance modpack, intended to be a base for other modpacks.

### What makes krnl special?
Unlike other optimization modpacks, krnl doesnt inpact any mechanics and doesnt add any extra visual features. In short, krnl only focuses on performance, nothing else. Additionally, krnl is optimized to be visually & mechanically indistinguishable from the vanilla game.

### Which mods are included?
Currently, the mods that are included are:
- [BadOptimizations](https://modrinth.com/mod/badoptimizations)
- [Better Block Entities](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-block-entities)
- [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
- [Concurrent Chunk Management Engine](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-fabric)
- [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling) (Excluded from 26.1.1)
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Fast Noise](https://modrinth.com/mod/zfastnoise)
- [ FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core)
- [ ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast)
- [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium)
- [More Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/moreculling)
- [ ScalableLux](https://modrinth.com/mod/scalablelux)
- [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)

### Which versions are supported?
Currently, every version between 1.21.11 & 26.1.2 are supported. Performance may vary between the versions but generally they should all perform mostly equal.
